leadText: Mission: Total Recall! (Japanese: リーリエとシルヴァディ、よみがえる記憶 and , the Resurrected Memory) is the 49th episode of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, and the 988th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on November 9, 2017, in New Zealand on March 1, 2018, and in the United States on March 29, 2018.
plainText:
Mission: Total Recall! (Japanese: リーリエとシルヴァディ、よみがえる記憶 and , the Resurrected Memory) is the 49th episode of Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon, and the 988th episode of the Pokémon animated series. It first aired in Japan on November 9, 2017, in New Zealand on March 1, 2018, and in the United States on March 29, 2018.
 

==Blurb==
 
 After accidentally seeing Gladion and coming face-to-face with Silvally, Lillie is once again unable to touch Pokémon—but she’s determined to change that! With Nebby’s help, she embarks on a journey to recall the memories behind her fear. But Faba wants none of it, having been responsible for Silvally’s creation in the first place. Vowing to make sure Lillie never remembers her past, Faba captures her, and she’s again filled with fear. But Silvally rescues Lillie, and when she remembers that it was the one who saved her in the past, her fear of touching Pokémon finally vanishes! 

==Plot==
 writes in her diary about the events of the previous episode and how she is now afraid to touch Snowy again. During nightfall, confronts on the beach, upset over what happened with Lillie and . Ash tries to apologize for Nebby's actions but Gladion won't listen. Returning to his motel room, Gladion is met by who has heard what happened to Lillie. He has come to retrieve , claiming that these are 's wishes. Gladion refuses, leading to a battle between their Pokémon but Gladion is soon defeated. prevents Gladion from sending Type: Null out by using on Gladion. With Gladion immobilized, Faba takes Type: Null's Premier Ball from him. 

Ash and are supportive towards Lillie over what happened when and join them. Another attempt at making contact with Snowy causes Lillie to freeze. When school ends, Ash joins Lillie and Snowy as they walk home. As they walk, Lillie guesses that Ash has met with Gladion which shocks Ash but subsequently confirms. Lillie reveals what happened when she encountered Gladion and Type: Null. Ash tries to cheer Lillie up which helps and Lillie decides to remember everything that happened. As a result of that, Nebby starts ing them to various locations from Lillie's past, which brings back memories of her and her family. Soon, Nebby teleports them to the research area underneath Aether Paradise. In his lab, Faba places the Premier Ball containing Type: Null in a drawer and is alerted to the presence of Ash and Lillie from the security system.

Walking around, Lillie recalls that she has been here before and are spotted by . At Lusamine's house, Gladion confronts Lusamine over what Faba said to him but she tells Gladion that she didn't tell Faba to retrieve Type: Null. She remembers that Faba reported Type: Null to be a failure and asks Gladion to tell her what he knows. Faba is instructing Team Rocket to bring Lillie to him so he can make her forget the memories she's remembered but Team Rocket refuse and walk off. Ash and Lillie soon find themselves confronted by Hypno and who send Ash flying as Faba grabs Lillie and takes her away. Gladion and Lusamine search for Type: Null's Poké Ball in Faba's lab and as soon as they find it, an alarm sounds. Faba has Hypno start to erase Lillie's memories only to be stopped by .

Nebby protects them from Hypno's Hypnosis as the battle continues. Alakazam takes Lillie into the air as Gladion and Lusamine arrive. Gladion sends out Type: Null who breaks free of its mask, turning into . Silvally frees Lillie from Alakazam, which causes Lillie to recall more memories. She remembers that Silvally had previously saved her from and that Faba was there when it happened. With help from the Dark Memory, Silvally is able to defeat Faba with as Lusamine apologizes to Lillie as Faba recalls both of his Pokémon into their Poké Balls and sneaks away. Lillie thanks Silvally and finds herself now able to touch Pokémon again.

Host: James
Choices: , , , 
Answer: Hypno
This episode is officially identified as the 1,000th episode of the Pokémon animated series by The Pokémon Company in Japan.
The count includes all episodes broadcast during the show's regular time-slot: all regular episodes including Holiday Hi-Jynx, Snow Way Out!, and the special episodes from Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl, Pokémon the Series: Black & White, and Pokémon the Series: XY.
In the dub version, The Professors' New Adventure! is identified as the 1,000th episode instead.
This episode marks the first appearance of a Hypno in the since its cameo in Spontaneous Combusken!, 552 episodes earlier.
This episode marks the first time is used in the animated series, despite the move having existed since Generation IV.
As of this episode, all variations of have been used in the animated series.
, , , , , , and a narrate the preview for the next episode.
The English dub title could be a reference to the action film series and/or the 1990 sci-fi action film .

===Errors===
 
During Lillie's flashbacks of her with and at the beach, Lusamine's swimsuit is a two-piece, but during the first scene of them riding a , her swimsuit is a one-piece.
When Faba's Hypno falls back after being hit by 's , Hypno has an extra toe on its foot.

===Dub edits===
In the dub, when Ash is describing to Lillie how Gladion felt when they met, he mentions instead of .
